verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say each finding explains how to fix it, and that you can let Qodo apply the fix directly. A Fix with Chat Agent option also remediates issues from the PR chat, so applying fixes from review is supported. The evidence never shows these fixes appearing as committable suggested diffs in review comments, nor that applying one is a single click. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline committable suggestion diffs (e.g. native suggestion blocks), confirmation of the one-click apply/commit flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
